symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1430: list-operation `$L = sort $BookChunkList by Similarity desc;` with Similarity declared on the generalization wrote `Embeddings_SemanticSearch.BookChunk.Similarity`; mxbuild CE1613 "The selected attribute ... no longer exists." Describe round-trips identically, so a describe-only comparison calls it in sync.
cause: addListOperationAction's ListOpSort case qualified a bare attribute as listEntity + "." + attr. The retrieve `sort by` path had been fixed for the same class (CapTrackV2 §13) with resolveAttributeInEntityHierarchy, but the list-operation sort was a separate copy of the qualification and was not.
fix: ListOpSort qualifies via fb.resolveAttributeInEntityHierarchy, falling back to the list entity when the model does not resolve it (unit tests without a backend, unknown attribute). FIND/FILTER already go through resolveMemberChange, which walks the hierarchy.
insight: **When a qualification bug is fixed, grep every `entityType + "." +` in the builder — the fix for one path does not reach its copies.** The retrieve sort, list sort and aggregate attribute each built Module.Entity.Attr independently; only the first walked the generalization chain. The aggregate `sum/min/max $L by Attr` path still prefixes blindly (same CE1613 class, not fixed here). Describe cannot detect this: it prints the bare attribute name either way, so only the stored AttributeQualifiedName (bson dump) or mxbuild shows it. The test reuses inheritedSortBackend from the §13 test; written before the fix it failed with stored [SyntheticApp.AppUser.Name].
